headline: 13 core contracts catalogued on BNB Chain; asBNB staking, token, minting, and governance infrastructure discovered with audit evidence

findings.text: BscScan tag search and Aster docs discovered 13 contract addresses on BNB Chain: asBNB (token + minting), asCAKE (token + minting), asBTC (token + minting), asUSDF (token + minting), USDF (token + minting), ASTER token, Aster Treasury, and slisBNB input token.
Official deployed contracts documentation found at https://docs.asterdex.com/overview/smart-contracts.md listing all asBNB, asCAKE, asBTC, asUSDF, USDF, and Treasury contracts with roles.

Audit evidence catalogued: Salus Security audit for asBNB, PeckShield audits for asBNB and USDF recorded in https://docs.asterdex.com/about-us/audit-reports (search result 16-1 confirms report names and dates: AsBNB_audit_report_2024-12-11.pdf, PeckShield-Audit-Report-asBNBEarn-v1.0.pdf, PeckShield-Audit-Report-USDFEarn-v1.0.pdf).
No GitHub repository recorded in protocol context or discovered via search. GitHub deployment artifacts unavailable.
Protocol operates on single chain (BNB Chain / Binance). All 13 discovered addresses are on BNB Chain (chainId 56). No cross-chain deployment variants found.
No factory contracts identified in discovered set. asBNB, asCAKE, asUSDF, asBTC are discrete minting contracts, not factories producing child pools.

Role taxonomy applied: asBNB (token), asBNB Minting Contract (minting), Treasury (treasury/admin), ASTER (token, governance), slisBNB (token/input), USDF (token), asCAKE/asBTC/asUSDF and their minting counterparts (token/minting).
All 13 addresses traced to fetched sources: docs.asterdex.com smart contracts page and docs.asterdex.com asBNB minting page. Every entry grounded in evidence[].

rationale.verdict: Catalogued 13 contract addresses from official Aster docs, Treasury address from BscScan tagged entry, and governance token from search results. Audit evidence for asBNB and USDF confirmed from docs audit reports page. No GitHub repo, single-chain deployment (BNB Chain), no factories or child contracts. Discovery complete within scope.

protocol_metadata.about: Aster asBNB is a liquid staking derivative that allows users to stake BNB or slisBNB through the Aster Earn product to mint asBNB, earning yield from Binance Launchpool rewards, HODLer airdrops, and Megadrop distributions. The protocol is part of the broader Aster ecosystem, a decentralized perpetual exchange offering Trade & Earn features where yield-bearing tokens like asBNB serve as trading collateral. The protocol integrates with Lista DAO for underlying staking mechanics and is backed by security audits from Salus Security and PeckShield.
